_comment: Site-specific values. Copy to manager/site.json (gitignored). All optional; sane public defaults apply when omitted.
_HOSTIF: Guests' NAT uplink. Empty/omitted = the default-route interface (auto). Set a NIC name only to override; one that does not exist is ignored (logged).
_HOST_FIREWALL: Opt-in host firewall (mgr/netfw.py): "1" adds the chains KAIM56-IN/-FWD/-PRE. Preview: cd manager && python3 -m mgr.netfw --dry-run; rollback: python3 -m mgr.netfw --rollback (as root).
_HOST_FW_MANAGER_FROM: With HOST_FIREWALL: who may reach :8700 over the LAN (comma list of IPs/nets, e.g. the reverse proxy). Empty = the uplink's subnet.
